inputs.name: r
inputs.tooltip: Relative step size for the intermediate stage (c2 node)

presentation.description:
This sampler node can represent multiple samplers:

seeds_2
- default setting

exp_heun_2_x0
- solver_type=phi_2, r=1.0, eta=0.0

exp_heun_2_x0_sde
- solver_type=phi_2, r=1.0, eta=1.0, s_noise=1.0

inputs.name: return_actual_sigma
inputs.tooltip:
Return the actual sigma value instead of the value used for interval checks.
This only affects results at 0.0 and 1.0.

source_reference.reference_runtime: NumPy 2.3.5 adapter; pinned node AST and Flow sigma/percent methods, not PyTorch runtime certification

sampler_consumption_reference.runtime: pinned AST, NumPy float32 adapter, deterministic VE profile
